macros.name: listinglabel
macros.doc: The style in which the label is set can be altered by re-defining \listinglabel.

macros.name: verbatimtabsize
macros.doc: The size of the tabs is stored in \verbatimtabsize, and persists between uses of the environments.

envs.name: boxedverbatim
envs.doc: \begin{boxedverbatim} puts the contents of a verbatim environment in a framing box.

envs.name: listingcont
envs.doc: \begin{listingcont} continues from the place where the last listing left off.

envs.name: listingcont*
envs.doc: \begin{listingcont} continues from the place where the last listing left off.
